whatChanged.before: each gate read the durable file itself (`<stateRoot>/watchdog/hold/<teamId>.json`, tolerating both field spellings, mtime-keyed cache)

whatChanged.whyItIsSound: cordis's `Context#get(name, strict)` is documented and implemented as an INJECT-FREE lookup — `_deps/cordis/lib/index.js`: `/** Read a service from the store without the inject requirement. */ get(name, strict = true) { return getTraceable(this.ctx, this._getImpl(name, strict)?.value) }`. A host-plane adopted row can therefore resolve another host-plane row's service without an `inject` declaration, which matters because this gate lives in adopted code whose `inject` list is not ours to change.
